| -------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| `id`     | `string`         |             |
| `type`   | `string`         |             |
| `parent` | `string \| null` |             |
| `depth`  | `number`         |             |

### Harness

The adapter of one coding-agent CLI.

| Property            | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `bin`               | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | The name of the executable on PATH.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `authFiles`         | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Login files to copy into the throwaway home, relative to the user's home.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `canaries?`         | `((env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv) => { path: string; json?: string[] \| undefined; }[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | What the harness keeps of its own on the operator's machine, which a run must never change; the `no_writes_outside_workspace` check hashes it before and after. Absent: the adapter names none. Name what a person edits to change the harness's behaviour, not what the harness writes as it works: a live session writes the latter every turn.             |
| `authEnv`           | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Variables of the user's environment that carry the harness's login or choose its provider; they reach it by name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `capabilities`      | `ReadonlySet<"subagents" \| "multiTurn" \| "userInvoke" \| "toolOutputs" \| "assistantText" \| "turnGrouping" \| "childCalls" \| "childText" \| "rules" \| "rulesReport" \| "hooks" \| "history" \| "historyNative" \| "askUser" \| "toolDurations" \| "sessionStore" \| "compact" \| "clear" \| "resume" \| "mcp" \| "skillListing" \| "loadedReport" \| "isolated" \| "sandbox">` | What the adapter can observe or do, each proven by a parser test on a stream. A case that needs more is not applicable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `argvRevision`      | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | The revision of the command line the adapter builds, from 1. A change to the arguments that can change what a run does, such as a new flag, raises it, so that a stored result made with the earlier command line is not reused. The run key carries it for a revision above 1 only, so the keys of earlier runs stay what they were.                         |
| `status`            | `"real-model" \| "scripted" \| "unverified"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | How far the adapter is proven: a real model ran, a scripted endpoint ran, or neither (see agents/verified).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `invocation`        | `(input: RunInput) => Invocation`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `userInvocation?`   | `((invoke: Invoke) => string) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | The text that a user types to invoke a skill: the harness's own syntax, such as `/skill args`. Present exactly for an adapter with the `userInvoke` capability, which declares it only once the syntax is confirmed from the CLI.                                                                                                                             |
| `reportsCost`       | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Whether the adapter reads a cost from the stream. False for a harness whose stream states none: `--max-cost` cannot count its runs, so the command refuses it.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `isRateLimit?`      | `((error: string) => boolean) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Tells whether the error of a finished run is a rate limit, so that the run may be tried again after a wait (`--retries`). Absent: never. The patterns are not verified against real harnesses.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `pathOf`            | `(call: ToolCall) => string \| null`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | The file that a read-kind call targets, so that path extraction stays in the adapter.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `skillOf?`          | `((call: ToolCall) => string \| null) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | The skill that a skill-kind call names, with any plugin prefix still on it. Absent: the first string among the arguments `skill`, `name` and `id`.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `placedAfterSetup?` | `((input: RunInput) => Record<string, string>) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Finds the skill copies that the harness itself made during setup, which `invocation` could not place because they do not exist until the setup steps have run. Called after them and before the prompt.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `registerMcp?`      | `((servers: McpServerEntry[], input: McpRegistration) => void) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Tells the harness about the mock MCP servers of a case, for an adapter with the `mcp` capability, which declares it only once the registration mechanism is confirmed from the CLI. Called once per run, before the harness starts. It writes what the harness reads into `dir`, and `invocation` then adds the flag that names it when it is given `mcpDir`. |
| `mcpCalls?`         | `"stream" \| "log" \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Where the calls to a run's mock MCP servers are seen, for an adapter with the `mcp` capability. `stream` (the default): the stream shows them, so the mock log is only a cross-check and a run whose log and stream disagree is invalid. `log`: the stream cannot show them, so the runner merges the mock log into the transcript.                           |
| `parse`             | `(stdout: string) => Parsed`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | May throw on a stream it does not understand; the caller reports that as a failed run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `countTurns?`       | `((line: unknown, state: TurnState) => void) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Counts turns as the stream arrives, so that the runner can stop a run at `maxTurns`. Present exactly for an adapter with the `turnGrouping` capability. A turn is a main-thread assistant turn as that adapter's `turn` numbering has it; a subagent's turns never count. Called once per line of standard output that is a JSON value, in order.             |
| `foreign?`          | `((loaded: Loaded, subject: LoadedSubject \| null) => string[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Names what the harness reported that does not come from the subject, for a harness whose report needs more than the shared rule. Absent: `foreignDefault`.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `isolation?`        | `Isolation \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | How the adapter isolates a run, for an adapter with the `isolated` capability. `invocation` uses these same `args` and `env` when the run is isolated.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `isolationGap?`     | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Why a harness without `isolation` cannot run `--isolated`, for the docs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `rulesTargets?`     | `((files: RulesFile[]) => RulesTarget[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Where each of a subject's rule files goes, for an adapter with the `rules` capability, which declares it only once the mechanism is confirmed from the CLI. A pure function: the loader uses it to refuse a rule that would land on a file of a case's workspace or home.                                                                                     |
| `installRules?`     | `((files: RulesFile[], input: Pick<RunInput, "home" \| "workspace">) => string[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Installs a subject's rule files the way the harness reads them: a native rules directory, an instruction-file import, or both. Present exactly for an adapter with the `rules` capability. Called once per run, before the harness starts; it never overwrites a file.                                                                                        |
| `strip?`            | `((dir: string, options: SubjectOptions) => Stripped) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Removes what the options of a subject spec switch off (`hooks=off`, `agents=off`, `agents=except:<glob>`) from an export, which is a copy. Present for an adapter that knows where its harness reads hook configuration and agent definitions from; a spec that asks for such an option is a usage error for a harness without it.                            |
| `strays?`           | `((run: { home: string; placed: Record<string, string> \| undefined; }) => string[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Names what a finished run left in the run's home that the run did not place, such as skills the account synced there. The report of what loaded does not show them. Called while the home still exists.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `historyMode?`      | `"native" \| "preamble" \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | How a case's `history.json` reaches the agent unless `--history-mode` says otherwise. Absent: `preamble`, which every adapter can do, because the runner writes the block itself.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `installHistory?`   | `((history: History, where: Seeding) => { session: string; }) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Writes a history into the harness's own session store, where the harness resumes it as its active session. Present exactly for an adapter with the `historyNative` capability. Called after the setup steps and the login files, and before the harness starts.                                                                                               |
| `installSessions?`  | `((sessions: PriorSession[], where: Seeding) => void) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Writes earlier sessions into the harness's prior-session store. Present exactly for an adapter with the `sessionStore` capability. Called at the same time as `installHistory`.                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Isolation

The switches that make a harness load nothing but the subject, and what the run record proves of that.

| Property    | Type                     | Description                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `args`      | `string[]`               | Command-line arguments added when the run is isolated.                                   |
| `env`       | `Record<string, string>` | Environment variables added when the run is isolated.                                    |
| `proves`    | `string`                 | What the report of what loaded covers.                                                   |
| `notProven` | `string`                 | What no switch removes and the report does not show.                                     |
| `notes`     | `string`                 | Markdown bullet list of what the switches do and what was read in the CLI, for the docs. |

### Loaded

What a harness says it loaded at startup. Null means the harness does not report that kind of thing.

| Property     | Type                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `paths`      | `string[] \| null`                                       | The directories of its plugins.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `skills`     | `string[] \| null`                                       | The names of its skills, without any plugin prefix.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `agents`     | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `rules`      | `string[] \| null`                                       | The rule files the harness says it loaded, by the name it reports; not what the run installed.                                                                                                           |
| `hooks`      | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `mcpServers` | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `ruleTexts?` | `string[] \| null \| undefined`                          | The text of each rule and instruction file the harness says it loaded, for a harness that states the text. Absent or null: the harness states none, so `context_injected` cannot read rule text from it. |
| `rawSkills?` | `string[] \| null \| undefined`                          | The skill names as the harness listed them, with any plugin prefix, for an adapter that has one.                                                                                                         |
| `plugins?`   | `{ name: string; path: string; }[] \| null \| undefined` | The plugins with their names, for an adapter that reports them.                                                                                                                                          |

### LoadedSubject

A plugin or a skills folder: a subject that puts something into the harness.

```ts
type LoadedSubject = Pick<Subject, "skills" | "skillDirs"> & {
  kind: "plugin" | "skills";
  dir: string;
  /** The plugin's own name, which prefixes its skills in the skill tool. Absent or null: no name is known. */
  pluginName?: string | null;
};
```

### Parsed

A harness's output stream in the one shape every harness shares. Null means the harness does not report the field.

| Property       | Type                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `finalText`    | `string`                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `toolCalls`    | `ToolCall[]`                                  | Always `callsOf(transcript)`: an adapter never builds it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `transcript`   | `TranscriptEvent[]`                           | Every text, tool call and tool result the stream shows, in order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `sessionId`    | `string \| null`                              | The harness's own id of the session, for a stream that carries one; null otherwise.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `tokens`       | `Tokens \| null`                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `agentTokens?` | `Record<string, Tokens> \| null \| undefined` | Tokens by agent id, summed from the usage of each assistant message; null where the stream states none. Absent: null.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `costUsd`      | `number \| null`                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `loaded`       | `Loaded`                                      | What the harness says it loaded at startup: its plugin directories, skills, agents, rules, hooks and MCP servers.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `mcpStatus?`   | `Record<string, string> \| null \| undefined` | The state each MCP server reported at startup, by name (`connected`, `failed`, ...), for a harness that states one. Null or absent: it states none.                                                                                                                                      |
| `error`        | `string \| null`                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `askedUser?`   | `boolean \| null \| undefined`                | True when the harness itself says the agent asked the user and stopped for the answer, which an adapter reads from its own stream. Null or absent: it says nothing. Only an adapter with the `askUser` capability sets it; the signals are unconfirmed against a real run until Task 29. |
| `hitMaxTurns?` | `boolean \| undefined`                        | True when the harness's own result says it stopped at its turn limit. Such a stop is no error. Absent: false.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `unfinished?`  | `boolean \| undefined`                        | True when `error` is only that the stream has no ending (no result, `turn_end` or `step_finish` event), which is what a stream cut by a stop or a timeout looks like. Any other error, a harness-reported one included, leaves it false. Absent: false.                                  |

### Tokens

Token counts; input counts every prompt token, cached ones included.

| Property | Type     | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `input`  | `number` |             |
| `output` | `number` |             |

### ToolCall

One tool call of the agent.

| Property      | Type                                                                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`                                                                                                                 | The harness's own tool name.                                                                                                                               |
| `kind`        | `"mcp" \| "shell" \| "read" \| "write" \| "edit" \| "search" \| "web" \| "skill" \| "subagent" \| "question" \| "other"` |                                                                                                                                                            |
| `input`       | `unknown`                                                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                            |
| `index?`      | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                    | The call's position in the run's list, from 0. Set once, after parsing; an adapter never sets it, and a 0.0.1 record lacks it.                             |
| `turn?`       | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                    | The assistant turn that issued the call, counted from 1. Only an adapter with the `turnGrouping` capability sets it.                                       |
| `durationMs?` | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                    | How long the call took, from its tool result, where the stream says. Only an adapter with the `toolDurations` capability sets it.                          |
| `userTurn?`   | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                    | The user turn the call belongs to, counted from 1, in a case with `turns`. Absent for a single prompt.                                                     |
| `agent?`      | `AgentRef \| undefined`                                                                                                  | The agent that made the call (depth 0 is the main agent, id `main`). Absent in a 0.0.1 record, which means the main agent.                                 |
| `dispatch?`   | `Dispatch \| undefined`                                                                                                  | What the dispatch asked for, on a `subagent` call; null in each field the harness's stream does not show.                                                  |
| `source?`     | `"mock-log" \| undefined`                                                                                                | `mock-log` for a call that only the mock MCP servers' log shows; its agent is then of type `unknown`. Absent otherwise.                                    |
| `native?`     | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                    | On an `mcp` call: the harness's own tool name, such as `mcp__tracker__get_issue`, which `name` maps to `<server>.<tool>`. A `name` pattern matches either. |

### TranscriptEvent

One step of a run, in the one shape every harness shares.

| Property      | Type                                                                                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `index`       | `number`                                                                                                                              | The event's position in the run, from 0.                                                                                                              |
| `turn`        | `number \| null`                                                                                                                      | The assistant turn, counted from 1; null where the harness has no grouping.                                                                           |
| `userTurn`    | `number`                                                                                                                              | Which user turn this answers: from 1 in a case with `turns`, 0 for a single prompt.                                                                   |
| `role`        | `"user" \| "assistant" \| "tool" \| "system"`                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `agent`       | `AgentRef`                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `type`        | `"text" \| "tool_call" \| "tool_result" \| "hook" \| "lifecycle"`                                                                     |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `callId?`     | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | Joins a `tool_call` to its `tool_result`.                                                                                                             |
| `kind?`       | `"mcp" \| "shell" \| "read" \| "write" \| "edit" \| "search" \| "web" \| "skill" \| "subagent" \| "question" \| "other" \| undefined` |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `name?`       | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `input?`      | `unknown`                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                       |
| `dispatch?`   | `Dispatch \| undefined`                                                                                                               | What the dispatch chose, on a `tool_call` of kind `subagent` whose adapter reads it.                                                                  |
| `output?`     | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | What the tool returned, on a `tool_result`, as decoded text.                                                                                          |
| `text?`       | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | What the assistant said, on a `text`.                                                                                                                 |
| `bytes?`      | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | The UTF-8 size of `text` or `output` as decoded, before any cut. Each invalid byte sequence was already replaced by one U+FFFD, which is three bytes. |
| `truncated?`  | `boolean \| undefined`                                                                                                                | True when `text` or `output` was cut; `bytes` keeps the original size.                                                                                |
| `isError?`    | `boolean \| undefined`                                                                                                                | On a `tool_result`: whether the harness marked the call as failed.                                                                                    |
| `durationMs?` | `number \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | On a `tool_result`, where the stream says how long the call took.                                                                                     |
| `hook?`       | `HookEvent \| undefined`                                                                                                              | On a `hook`: the hook that ran. A hook event is never a tool call, so no tool check counts it.                                                        |
| `at?`         | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | When the event happened, as an ISO 8601 time, where the stream states it. No adapter reads one today; the events of the mock log have one.            |
| `native?`     | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                 | On an `mcp` `tool_call` or its result: the harness's own tool name, as `ToolCall.native` has it.                                                      |
| `source?`     | `"mock-log" \| undefined`                                                                                                             | `mock-log` for an event that the runner took from the mock MCP servers' log, not from the harness's stream. Absent otherwise.                         |

### RunMeta

What a command records about how its runs were made, so that a number can be traced to its tools.

| Property          | Type                                                                                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toolVersion`     | `string`                                                                                        | The version of this package.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `harnessVersions` | `Record<string, string \| null>`                                                                | For each harness that the command could start, the first line of `<bin> --version`; null when that failed.                                                                                                                                        |
| `models`          | `{ agent: string \| null; judge: string \| null; decision: string \| null; }`                   | The models of the agent, the judge and the decision checks; null when not set.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `subjects`        | `{ label: string; revision: string; dirty: boolean \| null; options?: string \| undefined; }[]` | The subjects. `revision` is the content hash of what a run loads. `dirty` is true when the working tree has uncommitted changes under the subject's path, false for a git ref, and null when the subject is not in a git repository or is "none". |
| `caseHashes`      | `Record<string, Record<string, string>>`                                                        | The hash of each case as a run on that harness sees it, by harness id and case id. It is the hash that the run key uses, so a check that the harness dropped (`ifUnsupported: "skip"`) is not in it.                                              |
| `isolated`        | `boolean`                                                                                       | Whether the command ran with `--isolated`.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `lenient?`        | `boolean \| undefined`                                                                          | Whether the command ran with `--lenient`. Absent from earlier results.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `historyMode?`    | `"native" \| "preamble" \| undefined`                                                           | The `--history-mode` of the command. Absent when it was not set, and from earlier results.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `sandbox?`        | `SandboxCapability \| undefined`                                                                | What the sandbox of `--sandbox` could enforce on the machine. Absent when the option was off, and from earlier results.                                                                                                                           |
| `judge?`          | `{ via: "api" \| "harness"; harness: string \| null; model: string \| null; } \| undefined`     | How the judged checks were scored: through the API or a harness session, which harness (null: the harness under test), and which model. Absent from earlier results, which say it in `results.json`'s `judge` text.                               |

### Progress

How far a command has got.

| Property     | Type             | Description                                                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `done`       | `number`         | Runs that are finished, those reused from an earlier command included.                    |
| `total`      | `number`         | Every run of the plan.                                                                    |
| `spentUsd`   | `number \| null` | What this command has spent, reused runs excluded; null while no run has reported a cost. |
| `unreported` | `number`         | How many costs of this command were not reported; the spend is then a lower bound.        |
| `etaMs`      | `number \| null` | The time left in milliseconds; null until a run of this command has finished.             |

### NotRun

A run of the plan that has no valid finished record: it was not started, or it was started and its graders were skipped.

| Property  | Type     | Description |
| --------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `harness` | `string` |             |
| `caseId`  | `string` |             |
| `subject` | `string` |             |
| `rep`     | `number` |             |

### CheckResult

A check with what it gave one run.

```ts
type CheckResult = Check & {
  /** Null when a judged check, a decision check or a command check got no usable answer. */
  score: number | null;
  /** The judge's reason, or why there is no score. */
  reason?: string;
  /** For a judge check with `votes` above 1: what each vote gave. A vote with no usable answer has a null score. */
  ballots?: { score: number | null; reason: string }[];
  /** For a decision check, the probability the model gave each allowed answer. */
  probabilities?: Record<string, number>;
  /** For a command check: what the command did, each stream cut to its last 2,000 bytes. */
  command?: Verdict["command"];
  /**
   * True for a check of a conditional reply turn that was not sent because the agent did not ask: its score is null,
   * and the run's score and validity leave it out. Absent otherwise.
   */
  notScored?: true;
};
```

| `subject`           | `string`                                                                         | The subject's label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `options?`          | `string \| undefined`                                                            | The options of the subject's spec, such as `hooks=off`, in one text, so that a resume never takes a record of another variant. Absent for a subject without options.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `caseId`            | `string`                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| `finalText`         | `string`                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `toolCalls`         | `ToolCall[]`                                                                     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `agentTokens?`      | `Record<string, Tokens> \| null \| undefined`                                    | The run's tokens by agent id (`main`, or the id of the dispatch call), summed from the usage of each assistant message; null where the stream does not state usage per message. `tokens` is unchanged. Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `skillsLoaded`      | `string[]`                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `skillEvents`       | `SkillEvent[]`                                                                   | Every call that gave the agent a skill or a file of one, with how and where. `skillsLoaded` is the names of its loads.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `transcriptFile?`   | `string \| null \| undefined`                                                    | The run's whole transcript, relative to the output directory; null when none was written. Absent from 0.0.1 records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `inputHash?`        | `string \| undefined`                                                            | The sha256 of what the agent saw: the prompt, files, setup, harness, model, `maxTurns` and env names; not the checks. Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `askedUser?`        | `boolean \| null \| undefined`                                                   | What the harness reported of stopping for the user's answer (`Parsed.askedUser`), for `ended_awaiting_user` at case level; null when it reports nothing. Absent from a record made before the question kind, which `rescore` does not score `asked_user` and `ended_awaiting_user` from.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `userTurns?`        | `TurnRecord[] \| undefined`                                                      | Each turn of a case with `turns`, in order, with what it said and whether it was sent. Absent for a single prompt.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `turnChanges?`      | `ChangedFiles[] \| undefined`                                                    | What each turn created, modified and deleted in the workspace, from a hash taken after it (no files are copied); the order of `userTurns`. Absent for a single prompt.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `workspaceArchive?` | `WorkspaceArchive \| null \| undefined`                                          | The archive of the run's workspace, seed, remotes and home (`--keep-workspaces`); null when none was kept. Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `subjectLoaded`     | `boolean \| null`                                                                | Whether the harness reported the subject as loaded at startup; null when it reports nothing, or when there is nothing to load.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `loaded`            | `Loaded`                                                                         | What the harness reported as loaded at startup; a kind it does not report is null.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `isolated`          | `boolean`                                                                        | Whether the run was started with `--isolated`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `historyMode?`      | `"native" \| "preamble" \| null \| undefined`                                    | How the case's `history.json` reached the agent: "native" or "preamble"; null for a case with no history. Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `strippedLoaded?`   | `string[] \| undefined`                                                          | Agents and skills that the subject's options removed and the harness reported as loaded anyway; the run is invalid. Absent when there are none.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `unexpected`        | `string[]`                                                                       | The names of what the harness reported that does not come from the subject, whether or not `isolated` is set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `mcpProblems?`      | `string[] \| undefined`                                                          | Why the run's mock MCP servers cannot be trusted: a server that did not connect or was not reported, an MCP server that is neither a mock nor the subject's, a mock log that disagrees with the stream. The run is invalid. Absent when there is nothing wrong.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `reportMissing`     | `boolean`                                                                        | True when the harness should report its plugins and skills (`loadedReport`) and left one out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `judgeProblem`      | `string \| null`                                                                 | Why the judge session, which loads nothing, does not prove it loaded nothing; null when it does, or when no isolated judge ran.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `subjectMutated`    | `boolean`                                                                        | Whether the run changed anything in its copy of the subject. Always false for "none".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `subjectChanges`    | `ChangedFiles \| null`                                                           | What the run created, modified and deleted in its copy of the subject; null for "none".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `changedFiles`      | `ChangedFiles`                                                                   | What the run created, modified and deleted in its workspace, compared with the seed taken before the harness started.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `canaryChanges?`    | `CanaryReport \| undefined`                                                      | What changed in the canaries (the operator's home dotfiles and the project root) while the harness ran, each path with how it differs, for a case with a `no_writes_outside_workspace` check. Absent for a case without one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `checks`            | `CheckResult[]`                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `preconditions?`    | `CheckResult[] \| undefined`                                                     | The case's `preconditions` with their scores. A precondition that scores 0 makes the run invalid; none counts in the run's score. Absent for a case with none.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `rules?`            | `{ installed: string[]; reportedLoaded: string[] \| null; } \| undefined`        | What the run did with the subject's rules (`rules`, `instructionFile`): `installed` is where the adapter put each file, as `home/<path>` or `workspace/<path>`, and empty for a harness that installs none; `reportedLoaded` is what the harness says it loaded, relative to the run's home, null when it reports no rule. Absent when the subject names no rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `score`             | `number \| null`                                                                 | The run score, null when the run is invalid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `judge`             | `(Usage & { calls: number; cacheHits?: number \| undefined; }) \| null`          | What the judged checks cost, kept apart from the run's own numbers; null when no judge ran.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `decision`          | `(Usage & { calls: number; }) \| null`                                           | What the decision checks cost, kept apart in the same way; null when no request was sent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `attempts?`         | `{ error: string; costUsd: number \| null; durationMs: number; }[] \| undefined` | The error, the cost (null when none was reported) and the duration of each earlier attempt, when `--retries` made the run again: a harness crash, a rate limit, or a timeout before the harness produced any agent event. This record is the last attempt; its `attempt` in `results.jsonl` is the number of the attempt. Absent when the run was made once.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `skippedGraders?`   | `true \| undefined`                                                              | True when the command reached its `--max-cost` or `--max-duration` while this run was in flight, so its judged and decision checks were not asked. Such a run is invalid, and `--resume` makes it again in full. Absent otherwise.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `durationMs`        | `number`                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `tokens`            | `Tokens \| null`                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `costUsd`           | `number \| null`                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `stoppedBy?`        | `StoppedBy \| undefined`                                                         | Who ended the run: "agent" when the runner did not stop the process (a crash or a start that failed included, with `error` saying why), "maxTurns" when the run was stopped at the case's `maxTurns` (by the runner, or by Claude Code's own `--max-turns`), "timeout" when the time limit stopped it. A run stopped at `maxTurns` is valid and scored; a timeout is invalid unless the case sets `onTimeout: "score"`. For a stopped run, `tokens` and `costUsd` are null when the harness writes its totals only at the end. Absent from earlier records.               |
| `maxTurnsEnforced?` | `boolean \| null \| undefined`                                                   | Whether the harness counted turns against the case's `maxTurns`: null when the case sets none, true when it set one and the harness counts turns (it has `turnGrouping`), false when it set one and the harness cannot count them. The report lists the false ones under "Limits not enforced". Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `turns?`            | `number \| null \| undefined`                                                    | The main-thread turns the runner counted in the stream, subagent turns left out, up to the stop request for a run stopped at `maxTurns`, and also for an exit that was not a stop (output that arrives after the request is not counted), and the lines read until the process was gone for a timeout (the drain included); null for a harness without `turnGrouping`. A run stopped at `maxTurns` shows at least `maxTurns + 1`, because the runner stops as the next turn begins, and turns that arrive in the same chunk are counted too. Absent from earlier records. |
| `firstOutputMs?`    | `number \| null \| undefined`                                                    | Milliseconds from the start of the prompt to the first byte of the harness's output; null when it wrote none. Absent from earlier records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

### Variant

One way to put a case to the agent: a paraphrase, a pressure, a held-out check. It shares everything else with its case.

| Property        | Type                    | Description                                                                                       |
| --------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | `string`                | Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; unique within the case. The case runs as `<case id>@<id>`. |
| `promptAppend?` | `string \| undefined`   | Text appended to the case's `prompt.md`, after a blank line.                                      |
| `prompt?`       | `string \| undefined`   | The whole prompt, in place of `prompt.md`.                                                        |
| `heldout?`      | `boolean \| undefined`  | True for a variant that runs only with `--heldout`.                                               |
| `tags?`         | `string[] \| undefined` | Tags added to the case's tags for this variant.                                                   |
